mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the unemployment rate above 5% signals weakening consumer demand and rising recession risk, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE > 5.0 for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals weakening demand, which reduces corporate earnings growth and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when RSAFS falls for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the industrial production index (INDPRO) signals stronger manufacturing output and economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when INDPRO rises for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, which raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the civilian labor force (PAYEMS) signals tighter labor market conditions and upward wage pressure, which reduces profit margins and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when PAYEMS rises for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the housing starts index (HOUST) signals stronger residential investment and consumer confidence, which boosts economic growth and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when HOUST rises for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the CPI inflation index (CPIAUCSL) below 2% signals easing price pressures and reduced recession risk, which supports higher equity valuations and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when CPIAUCSL < 102 for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).
